title: LISD Assistant Athletic Director Arrested on Assault Charge, Police Say
excerpt: Laredo police arrested Laredo ISD Assistant Athletic Director Fares Kamel Shrek, 43, on an assault charge after responding to a report in the 2800 block of Emory Loop on Monday.
content:
Laredo police arrested Laredo Independent School District Assistant Athletic Director Fares Kamel Shrek, 43, on an assault charge, according to KGNS, citing Laredo police.

Officers responded at about 12:04 p.m. Monday, Nov. 23, to an assault report in the 2800 block of Emory Loop and detained Shrek at the scene, according to KGNS. A woman known to Shrek told officers he allegedly assaulted her following a verbal altercation, according to police.

Shrek was booked into Webb County Jail on a charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, according to jail records, and was released Tuesday after posting a $10,000 bond, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

LISD Superintendent Guillermo Pro told KGNS the district is aware of the arrest, takes the allegations seriously, and will review the matter and take appropriate administrative action. Pro declined to share further details, citing the ongoing legal and personnel matter.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 24, 2026; Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 24, 2026.
